source.material: user-uploaded MP4; media not copied to repository

review.method: 12 visual moments compared side by side and audio PCM decoded at mono 16 kHz
review.evidence: Some visible camera/framing changes; main story defects remain at 540x960.

audio.note: Rain bed continues through narration gaps. Correlation and RMS do not verify spoken words.

issues.evidence: Dark sky dominates and water gauge is outside most of opening composition; tide rise does not read clearly.
issues.action: Market-side water gauge, front waterline, opening camera stay near the stalls.

issues.evidence: Gate still resembles corrugated garage shutter rather than sluice machinery.
issues.action: Add concrete buttresses, visible outgoing water channel and water-pressure geography.

issues.evidence: Market figures remain small and already holding goods at start of the warning.
issues.action: Respect event sequence: acknowledgement -> lift -> carry; evacuation starts only after warning.

issues.evidence: Tall blue translucent vertical block remains along left side of the market and masks visual meaning of water level.
issues.action: Remove long filled background roof polygon; replace with low bounded strip and shallow street flood.

changes: SVG coastal harbor: short roofline vs former giant polygon
Market-side tide gauge and foreground ripples
Opening camera reframing and AI-1..AI-6 story QA lessons
limitations: New code not yet judged via resulting MP4
